summary: Owen Byrne, 47, co-founder of digg.com, former programmer, educated in business and technology, lived in Montreal, Quebec, and Winnipeg, Canada, currently residing in Spain, strong interest in entrepreneurship and technology, experienced in startup culture, critical of age discrimination in tech, advocates for open-source contributions, enjoys running and has completed half-marathons, has a history of working in tech startups, expresses skepticism towards conventional education methodologies, has a family structure that includes a wife, and has a distinctive voice in discussions about tech industry dynamics and social issues.
